outcomes.title: Past Simple Verb Conjugation
outcomes.description: Student will be able to differentiate regular and irregular verbs in affirmative and negative past simple sentences.
outcomes.assessment_rubric_hint: Check if student avoids over-regularization like 'goed' and uses base form after didn't.

outcomes.title: Quantifier Precision (Some/Any/Much/Many)
outcomes.description: Student will be able to select appropriate quantifiers for countable and uncountable nouns in various sentence types.
outcomes.assessment_rubric_hint: Verify student uses 'any' in negatives and questions, and 'much' exclusively with uncountables.

outcomes.title: Comparative and Superlative Structures
outcomes.description: Student will be able to construct grammatically sound comparative and superlative adjective statements.
outcomes.assessment_rubric_hint: Ensure student does not stack double comparatives like 'more faster'.

outcomes.title: Ecosystem Comprehension and Environmental Vocabulary
outcomes.description: Student will be able to explain how living and non-living elements interact in Egyptian coastal ecosystems.
outcomes.assessment_rubric_hint: Assess whether student recognizes both biotic and abiotic components in ecosystem balance.
